thread:
maria: Heads-up — noticed a cost spike after we enabled a 250ms ingress_window on embeds. tiny requests are getting batched into multiple shards and cost per-embed jumped. anyone seen this? :thinking:

ajay: yup noticed in the dashboard. traffic with lots of 1-3 doc inputs exploded token overhead. not just batching — routing creates duplicate shard work when dims aren't normalized.

ben: can you paste the config? curious about batch size and route policy.

maria: config snippet: ```
ingress.window_ms = 250
batch.max_tokens = 1024
route.fallback = "nearest-cost"
preflight.enabled = true
```

katie: 250ms is kinda large for workloads that send single-sentence pods. That window increases prefix coalescing but also lengthens KV cache pressure and duplicates for mixed-dim requests. Suggest we try 100ms for small-embed paths.

ajay: agree. Also we should add a preflight quick-sample to detect dim/shape and pick soft-split vs single-shard. current preflight is expensive.

lucy: from console/UX side — customers are confused because cost estimator shows "avg token" but not the fragmentation penalty. We should surface an "estimated shard multiplier" in the route detail panel. sampling + example request would help.

ben: operationally we can emit telemetry: `embed.ingress.windowing.{sample_rate}.shard_multiplier` and a boolean `embed.preflight.fastpath` so we can see how many go through expensive preflight. set sample_rate=1% by default.

maria: +1. Also thinking of a lightweight checksum on input dims so runtime can decide fast: if all dims identical -> coalesce, else -> pre-split. checksum algo: md5 of dims array. cheap.

ajay: md5 ok but need to be careful with client-provided dims — we should validate shape in preflight. fallback if missing.

katie: proposal for rollout:
- default ingress.window_ms -> 100ms for `/v1/embeddings` in canary
- enable telemetry (1% sample) for shard_multiplier and preflight path
- add console meter: "Shard multiplier" and a per-route cost impact estimate
- opt-in full preflight via header `X-Embed-Preflight: full` for customers that want deterministic behavior

lucy: console mock: show a histogram of shard_multiplier over time, and a toggle to show only requests with mixed dims. also add a short tooltip: "Shard multiplier >1 indicates requests split across shards -> higher cost"

infra-bot: deploy-bot: canary config applied to env=staging for route `/v1/embeddings` at 2024-04-12T15:02Z

ben: quick note — batching/kernel selection relies on sequence length distribution. if we shorten window we might increase throughput variance. we'll need to tune `batch.max_inflight` simultaneously.

maria: action items:
- ajay: add lightweight dims-checksum + fastpath toggle (ETA 2d)
- ben: add telemetry counters and 1% sampler (ETA 1d)
- lucy: console mocks for shard multiplier (ETA 3d)
- katie: prepare canary plan + docs for header opt-in (ETA 2d)

ajay: noted. i'll open a tiny RFC/PR and include benchmark numbers with 100ms vs 250ms.

maria: thanks all. if telemetry shows high shard_multiplier we flip default to 100ms quickly. otherwise we keep 250ms for heavy-aggregation tenants. :thumbsup:
